generate_bash_completion: generate bash shell completion script from an argparse parser for the hermes CLI
generate_zsh_completion: generate zsh shell completion script from an argparse parser for the hermes CLI
generate_fish_completion: generate fish shell completion script from an argparse parser for the hermes CLI
